question: Should Google Meet attendance CSV exports intentionally add a leading apostrophe to every formula-like cell value to prevent spreadsheet execution?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but accepting changed raw CSV field bytes is a product compatibility choice rather than a correctness question automation can resolve.

options.title: Accept the bounded compatibility change
options.body: Merge the current sanitizer because it protects every CSV cell consistently and the LibreOffice proof confirms formula execution is neutralized.

options.title: Require a different CSV contract
options.body: Pause merge and specify an alternative representation or narrower sanitization policy, then require equivalent cross-spreadsheet proof and regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded compatibility change
recommendation.body: Merge the current sanitizer because it protects every CSV cell consistently and the LibreOffice proof confirms formula execution is neutralized.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects vincentkoc to the Google Meet plugin’s user-facing behavior and export surface.
